<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl custom" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_ck0002107057_AdvisoryAgreementEffectivePeriod', window );">Advisory agreement effective period</a></td>
<td class="text">2 years<span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="re">
<td class="pl custom" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_ck0002107057_AdvisoryAgreementDescription', window );">Advisory agreement description</a></td>
<td class="text">Advisory Agreement: The Company will enter into the Investment Advisory and Management Agreement (the &#8220;Advisory Agreement&#8221;) with TCW Asset Management Company LLC (the &#8220;Adviser&#8221;), a registered investment adviser under the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, as amended. The Advisory Agreement will remain effective for a period of two years from its effective date and will remain in effect from year to year thereafter if approved annually by (i) the vote of the Company&#8217;s board of directors, or by the vote of a majority of the Company&#8217;s outstanding voting securities, and (ii) the vote of a majority of the Company&#8217;s directors who are not &#8220;interested persons&#8221; (as defined in Section 2(a)(19) of the 1940 Act) of the Company, the Adviser or any of their respective affiliates (the &#8220;Independent Directors&#8221;). The Advisory Agreement will automatically terminate in the event of an assignment by the Adviser. &#160;The Advisory Agreement may be terminated by either party, by vote of the Company&#8217;s board of directors or by a vote of the majority of the Company&#8217;s outstanding voting units or, if less, such lower percentage as required by the 1940 Act, without penalty upon not less than 60 days&#8217; prior written notice to the applicable party.<span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_IncentiveFeeDescription', window );">Incentive fee description</a></td>
<td class="text">the Adviser will receive an incentive fee (the &#8220;Incentive Fee&#8221;) as follows:(a)First, no Incentive Fee will be owed until the Unitholders have collectively received cumulative distributions pursuant to this clause (a) equal to their aggregate capital contributions in respect of all Units;(b)Second, no Incentive Fee will be owed until the Unitholders have collectively received cumulative distributions equal to a 6.0% internal rate of return on their aggregate capital contributions in respect of all Units (the &#8220;Hurdle&#8221;);(c)Third, the Adviser will be entitled to an Incentive Fee out of 100% of additional amounts otherwise distributable to Unitholders until such time as the Incentive Fee paid to the Adviser is equal to 12.5% of the sum of (i) the amount by which the Hurdle exceeds the aggregate capital contributions of the Unitholders in respect of all Units and (ii) the amount of Incentive Fee being paid to the Adviser pursuant to this clause (c); and(d)Thereafter, the Adviser will be entitled to an Incentive Fee equal to 12.5% of additional amounts otherwise distributable to Unitholders, with the remaining 87.5% distributed to the Unitholders.&#160;For the period from March 10, 2026 (Inception) to June 30, 2026, no Incentive Fees have been incurred.<span></span>
</td>
</tr>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.toggleNext( this );">- Definition</a><div><p>Description of the nature of the payments to managing member or general partner for incentive rights held including the fee rate, basis of calculation, relevant accounting period, whether the fee is paid to an entity other than the managing member or general partner, or if the fee is waived.</p></div>
